subject.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads

question: Is it acceptable to land bounded summary-oriented planning now while history-prune planning continues to clone full-fidelity message payloads?
rationale: The branch proves its implemented paths, but code inspection cannot determine whether partially covering the linked worst-case memory problem is the intended agents-runtime boundary or whether every worker operation must be bounded before merge.

options.title: Accept the scoped mitigation
options.body: Approve the documented history-prune exception, refresh the branch against current main, and land the proven reductions for summary-oriented operations.

options.title: Bound history pruning first
options.body: Require a separate fidelity-preserving representation or result protocol for history-prune planning before merging this worker-payload change.
